messages:
jamie: Hi — our org (org-id: org_6789) purchased Redwood via Azure Marketplace / Accelerator, but the partner credits never showed up on our account. Console still shows $0 promo balance and our card is getting charged. Anyone seen this?

sara: Sorry about that — can you paste the marketplace subscription id and the email on the Redwood account?

jamie: subscription id: 7f3a2b9a-azure-sub, email: jamie@acme.com. I also tried entering the partner invoice id in the billing UI and got an error: "unsupported provider".

mike: Quick checklist from support side: 1) Did you link the Azure billing account to the Redwood org? 2) Is this an Accelerator grant or a standard marketplace credit? Accelerator flow uses partner tokens.

jamie: It's an Accelerator grant — partner portal sent a promo token, not a marketplace entitlement. We copied the token into the UI and it failed. Token in email: ACRT-2026-9F3J. Partner case #AZ-5691.

elaine: That matches a class of cases we've seen where the partner grant created a pending entitlement but the partner->redwood mapping used a different tenant id. I'm going to kick an entitlement sync now. @billing-bot can you run `entitlement:sync --provider azure --sub 7f3a2b9a --org org_6789`?

billing-bot: entitlement-sync job queued (job id: q-4452). Started syncing partner entitlements and invoices.

mike: If the sync doesn't apply, we'll need the original partner email and the invoice or token (you shared ACRT-2026-9F3J — thanks). Also confirm there isn't a different email on Azure that would map to another org.

jamie: attaching screenshot: https://files.redwood.ai/attachments/1745/azure-credit-screenshot.png — partner case AZ-5691 as above. We only have jamie@acme.com across Azure and Redwood.

sara: Reassigning to partners and billing to check mapping. @partners please confirm partner-side mapping for subscription 7f3a2b9a -> org_6789.

partners: we see a grant issued to partner-account p-334 but it was recorded against azure-tenant t-990, not tenant t-123 (which maps to org_6789). We'll update the mapping and re-send the webhook/event to Redwood.

billing-bot: entitlement-sync job completed. Results: 1 applied, 2 pending. Token ACRT-2026-9F3J is pending partner mapping. Error summary: partner_webhook_not_matched.

mike: I'll try a manual dry-run apply from admin: `admin-cli credits:apply --org org_6789 --token ACRT-2026-9F3J --dry-run` -> returns success (would apply $25k). Running without --dry-run now.

billing-bot: apply job succeeded. Credit balance updated: +$25,000 promotional credits. New promo_expiry: 2026-09-30.

jamie: I can see the promo in the console now and API requests are no longer billed to our card. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

sara: Closing loop on this thread — we'll follow up with partners to audit the mapping logic and add an alert for partner_webhook_not_matched so cases are auto-escalated. cc @finance @eng.

mike: Filed internal follow-up INF-3212 to add automatic retry + partner mapping fallback and a dashboard for pending partner entitlements.

jamie: Appreciate it all :heart:
